{{2020–21 Mid-American Conference men's basketball standings}}
The '''2020–21 Bowling Green Falcons men's basketball team''' represented [[Bowling Green State University]] in the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Falcons, led by 6th-year head coach [[Michael Huger]], played their home games at the [[Stroh Center]] in [[Bowling Green, Ohio]] as members of the East Division of the [[Mid-American Conference]]. They finished the season 14-12, 10-8 to finish in 6th place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2021 MAC men's basketball tournament|MAC tournament]] to [[2020–21 Akron Zips men's basketball team|Akron]]. They received an invitation to the [[2021 College Basketball Invitational|CBI]] where they lost in the quarterfinals to [[2020–21 Stetson Hatters men's basketball team|Stetson]].

==Previous season==

The [[2019–20 Bowling Green Falcons men's basketball team|Falcons]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 21–10 overall, 12–6 in MAC play to finish second place in the East Division. They were scheduled to play [[2019–20 Toledo Rockets men's basketball team|Toledo]] in the [[2020 MAC men's basketball tournament|MAC tournament]] before it was cancelled due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]].
